command:
printf "name,age,note
'Single, Jane',30,ok
" > bug_singlequote.csv
printf 'name,age,note
 "Space, Jane",30,ok
' > bug_spacequote.csv
for f in bug_report.csv bug_singlequote.csv bug_spacequote.csv; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo "--- fmtcsv output ---"; .venv/bin/python fmtcsv.py "$f"; echo; done
title: Run fmtcsv on three quoted-comma CSV variants
